basic_details.job_title: CSGRC Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 35 years (as on the date of notification)

qualification.education_qualification: M.Sc. in any branch of Life Science/Agricultural Science from UGC recognised university with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST candidates).
qualification.details: Qualification: M.Sc. in any branch of Life Science/Agricultural Science from UGC recognised university with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST candidates) Experience: Desirable: working experience in Plant Tissue Culture, Cryopreservation and Molecular Analysis Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on the date of notification) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC 5 years, Women 5 years, Physically Challenged 5 years | Other conditions: | No TA/DA provided for interview. Canvassing will lead to cancellation of candidature. | Desirable: | Specialization in Biotechnology/Botany/Molecular Biology/Plant Physiology/Biochemistry/Genetics and Plant Breeding/Plant Genetic Resources/Plant Science Working experience in Plant Tissue Culture, Cryopreservation and Molecular Analysis will be preferred

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 31,000 + HRA (first two years) and Rs. 35,000 + HRA (third year) with NET/GATE; Rs. 21,000 + HRA (first two years) and Rs. 25,000 + HRA (third year) without NET/GATE

how_to_apply: Appear for the walk-in interview at 10.00 AM on 03.12.2026 at the Auditorium, Main Office Building, CSGRC, Hosur.
Bring the listed documents with two sets of self-attested photocopies.
The notice includes an application format for the post of JRF; self-attested copies of relevant certificates need to be enclosed.
important_instructions: No TA or DA will be provided to attend the interview The decision of the Director-CSGRC shall be final and binding in all respects Bring a valid email ID and telephone/mobile number

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.Sc. in any branch of Life Science/Agricultural Science from UGC recognised university with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST candidates) Experience: Desirable: working experience in Plant Tissue Culture, Cryopreservation and Molecular Analysis Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on the date of notification) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC 5 years, Women 5 years, Physically Challenged 5 years Other conditions: No TA/DA provided for interview. Canvassing will lead to cancellation of candidature. Desirable: Specialization in Biotechnology/Botany/Molecular Biology/Plant Physiology/Biochemistry/Genetics and Plant Breeding/Plant Genetic Resources/Plant Science Working experience in Plant Tissue Culture, Cryopreservation and Molecular Analysis will be preferred

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary, on a contractual basis and co-terminus with the project Project duration August 2026 to July 2029 (3 years)

content_sections.heading: How Will CSGRC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in Interview Recruitment procedures as per the Guidelines for Research Fellow (JRF/SRF/RA) hiring under CSB-coded R&D projects

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: One recent passport size photograph Certificates and mark sheets for all education qualifications (SSLC, PUC/HSC, B.Sc., M.Sc., etc.) Proof of date of birth No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer, if applicable Certificates/documents and copies of research experience, trainings, publications (if any) Community certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates, if applicable

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSGRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Appear for the walk-in interview at 10.00 AM on 03.12.2026 at the Auditorium, Main Office Building, CSGRC, Hosur. Bring the listed documents with two sets of self-attested photocopies. The notice includes an application format for the post of JRF; self-attested copies of relevant certificates need to be enclosed.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA or DA will be provided to attend the interview The decision of the Director-CSGRC shall be final and binding in all respects Bring a valid email ID and telephone/mobile number

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for CSGRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 3 December 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CSGRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CSGRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 3 December 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on the date of notification). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC 5 years, Women 5 years, Physically Challenged 5 years.

faq.answer: Rs. 31,000 + HRA (first two years) and Rs. 35,000 + HRA (third year) with NET/GATE; Rs. 21,000 + HRA (first two years) and Rs. 25,000 + HRA (third year) without NET/GATE.

faq.answer: M.Sc. in any branch of Life Science/Agricultural Science from UGC recognised university with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST candidates).
